page.layout: One page of text in verse with headings in italics and underlined mottoes; faint show-through from the reverse side; a large decorative initial at left (C of Cygnus area); catchword and small mark at foot right.

main_text.head: Malua herba ex eodem. Gratus animus.
main_text.p:
Quem succum tellure trahit, cum fœnore reddit:
Pinguius & linquit confita malua folum.
Stirpis ad exemplum gratæ, memor esto rependas
Vt benefactori præmia digna tuo.
main_text.head: Ex malis bona. Gemma in capite bufonis nata.
main_text.p:
Ecce tibi: quis non miretur? nata veneno
In medio, profert gemma salutis opem.
Et mirare malo doctoris ab ore nefandi,
Dogma fluens, cœli si tibi monstret iter?
main_text.head:
Odor ex thure; Odor ex sulphure.
Mors piorum & impiorum.
main_text.p:
Iniustum iustumque manet mors vna: quid ergo
Vnius est inter funus & alterius?
Expediam verbo: quàm gratus, thure Sabæo
Ignibus iniecto, naribus halat odor:
Tam bene sanctorum mors: sed damnata malorum,
Ceu vapor ex vito sulphure teter, olet.
main_text.head:
Harpastum saliens in faciem luforis.
Stulti non laudandi.
main_text.p:
Acre tensa reples quæ nunc Harpasta reclusa,
In faciem salient mox tumefacta tuam.
Imineritis stolidè tumidum qui laudibus effers,
Grande feres probrum laudibus ipse tuis.
main_text.head: Sydera nocte latentia. Pietas premitur, non opprimitur.
main_text.p:
Sit nox atra licet, cœli non opprimet astra,
Astrorum quamuis lucida dona premat.
Sic premitur pietas, rebus vexatur & arctis:
Rebus at hæc arctis non tamen opprimitur.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page appears throughout the margins and between lines. Some words in the mottoes are underlined in the original. Left margin contains a large decorative initial (C) and a bracketed flourish, not transcribed as text. The line "Ex malis bona" and the wording "Harpastum saliens" are uncertain in places; "vito" and "luforis" may be misprints for the original forms.
